messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGER: spike in 5xx (502/504) from model-serving cluster in us-east-1. Error rate: 18% over last 3m. Autotriggered runbook: runtime-5xx. Paging oncall-sre.
oncall-sre: seeing the alerts, joining. any customer-facing impact?
carina: confirmed - dashboard shows a small cohort of requests failing during streaming generation. latency also up ~2x. Affected models: rwd-7b-v2 and rwd-13b-quant.
matt: logs show repeated `SIGSEGV` in model-runner worker on pod inference-rt-12. stacktrace attached below.
eng-runtime: paste: ```
[2026-03-17T09:12:03Z] model-runner[pid=1123] SIGSEGV at 0x7f8a3c.. in attention_kernel
backtrace:
  #0 0x7f8a3c.. attention_kernel
  #1 0x7f7b2d.. kv_cache_commit
  #2 0x7f6c1a.. request_loop
  OOM? GPU mem left: 0.8GB free
```
carina: hmm memory looks tight. We recently rolled quantized 13b to beta region. Could be quant kernel memory spike.
eng-runtime: agree. telemetry shows encoder memory growing then segfault. batching was at 16; reducing now.
oncall-sre: mitigation plan: 1) reduce max_batch_size to 4 for affected model variants, 2) temporarily disable streaming for rwd-13b-quant, 3) route traffic to rwd-7b-v1 fallback for customers that allow lower-capacity model, 4) scale up dedicated pool by +2 GPU nodes. I'll run steps 1-2 now.
support-lead: noted. opening customer impact note: support playbook -> "customers using rwd-13b-quant may see 502 or truncated responses. we're failing over where possible."
matt: applying batch change: `kubectl patch cm inference-config -p '{"data":{"rwd-13b-quant.max_batch":"4","rwd-13b-quant.streaming":"false"}}'`
eng-runtime: rolling config.. pods picked up new config, a few restarts. watching metrics.
carina: after the change error rate dropped to 6% in the last 2m. Some pods still OOMing during startup.
oncall-sre: scaling dedicated pool +2 nodes (request sent to autoscaler). expected spin-up ~90s.
eng-runtime: also taking one problematic node out of rotation: `kubectl cordon inference-n42; drain inference-n42 --ignore-daemonsets` to stop noisy worker.
matt: found one core dump from inference-rt-12. uploaded to /artifacts/incidents/3998887776/coredump.tar.gz and kicked off symbolization job.
carina: customer impact update: ~3% of requests still 502, mostly multi-turn streaming flows. support notified.
oncall-sre: temporary traffic routing policy: route model requests above 100 tokens to fallback model for known prod customers. pushing policy now.
eng-runtime: after routing change + scaling, 5xx stabilized to ~0.7% and latency back to normal. keeping mitigations for 30m.
support-lead: posting status to status.redwood.com and Slack #general with short blurb.
matt: root cause hypothesis: quant attention kernel regresses under high batch + long-prefix workloads causing GPU memory spike -> SIGSEGV during KV commit.
oncall-sre: next actions: 1) keep reduced batch + streaming disabled on quant variant for 2h, 2) revert rollout of rwd-13b-quant in us-east-1 until new build, 3) schedule hotfix for attention kernel, 4) create postmortem and link coredump + traces. tagging eng-runtime to lead fix.
eng-runtime: acknowledged. creating ticket INF-6231, will triage under priority P1 and loop in research for kernel analysis.
night-oncall: taking handoff at 09:45Z. will monitor and escalate if errors >2% persist.
support-lead: handing to night-oncall. all engineers: please add any follow-ups into INF-6231. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
